what_happened: Scene L9: green sponge_6 on the counter right of a dark wooden cutting_board_2 (holed board), sink on the left. Stage 0 normal: grasp 109, lifted 8 cm, carried 29 cm left over the board (124-164); stage 0 holds from 116 (online 128). Stage 1: the sponge first touched the board at 172 (counter 1), 217 (2), 265 (3) and 270 (4), mostly small motions near the board's right part. From 276 to 412 the policy made large sweeping strokes (sponge x from +0.04 to -0.29 m and back, ~34 cm) but the sponge centre stayed at z +29..35 mm above its counter height while it rests on this board at +25 mm after release, i.e. it was carried 4-9 mm above the board; the counter stayed at 4 for the whole sweep, although grasp=True almost throughout (q1 < 0.035) and every new point would have been >2 cm from the old ones. At 420-452 it lifted the sponge to +9 cm, lowered it and opened at ~463, leaving the sponge on the board; eef > 15 cm from the sponge at 477. Final counter: 4 contacts, sweep 0.099 m (needs 5 and 0.10). After that the arm retracted, the base turned and the robot looked around to 800 with no further attempt.
causal_chain: 4 board contacts by 270 -> 276-412 big wiping strokes executed a few mm ABOVE the board (no contact, counter frozen at 4 / 0.099 m) -> policy lifted and released the sponge at 463 as if done -> criterion short by 1 contact and 1 mm sweep -> no re-attempt, timeout 800
self_recovery: none: after the release the policy never returned to the sponge.
official_criterion_notes: Near-miss: 4/5 contacts and sweep 0.099/0.10. The video shows a convincing scrub; only the trace height shows that the long sweep did not touch the board. A 186-216 window where the counter was blind because finger_joint1 sat at its open limit (see summary) cost at most ~1 point here.

packet_facts: trace: counter increments 172,217,265,270 only; sponge z +29..35 mm during 276-412 vs +25.3 mm resting on board after release

uncertain_about: The few-mm gap is inferred from the sponge-centre height in the replay trace (tilt 1-6 deg could let an edge touch); the video resolution cannot show it. That the counter did not move while the sponge crossed 30 cm with grasp=True is solid evidence that there was no counted board contact.
